context: A uni student interviews a doctor about an awareness campaign
purpose: Teach: エイズ/原発/悲惨/脆弱/不能/早急/除去/友好

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、今日は啓発キャンペーンについて伺いたいんですが、なぜエイズをテーマに?
lines.en: Doctor, I'd like to ask about your awareness campaign today — why did you choose AIDS as the theme?
lines.style: Polite student opening an interview respectfully

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 正しい知識がまだ足りないんですよ。偏見の除去こそが、今回の一番の目的です。
lines.en: Accurate knowledge is still lacking. Removing prejudice is really the main goal of this campaign.
lines.style: Calm professional explaining the campaign's purpose clearly

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先日の原発事故の報道でも、誤情報が広がって悲惨な差別が起きましたよね。
lines.en: Even with the recent nuclear plant accident coverage, misinformation spread and tragic discrimination occurred, didn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful young interviewer drawing a parallel example

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ええ。社会的に脆弱な立場の人ほど、そうした風評の被害を受けやすいんです。
lines.en: Yes. People in socially vulnerable positions are the ones most easily hurt by such rumors.
lines.style: Measured doctor expressing genuine concern for vulnerable groups

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 完全に防ぐのは実現不能に近いと思うんですが、何か具体策はありますか?
lines.en: Achieving complete prevention seems nearly impossible — do you have any concrete countermeasures?
lines.style: Honest student pressing gently for practical answers

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 早急に学校教育に組み込むべきです。子どものうちから正しく学べば、変わります。
lines.en: We urgently need to integrate it into school education. If children learn correctly, things will change.
lines.style: Firm doctor advocating immediate educational reform with conviction

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。学生団体との友好関係を築く計画もあるとか?
lines.en: I see. I heard you also plan to build friendly relationships with student groups?
lines.style: Curious student following up with informed question

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、ぜひ一緒にやりましょう。若い声が、この運動を本当に動かす力ですから。
lines.en: Yes, please let's work together. Young voices are truly the force that moves this movement forward.
lines.style: Warm doctor extending sincere invitation to collaborate
